title: urlencode
summary: Percent-encode text for use in URLs.

gpu_support.notes: This text-only helper runs on the host. Numeric and provider-resident values are rejected before provider access.

description: `urlencode(text)` percent-encodes text for use in URLs. It is a RunMat language extension for scripts that need URL text utilities.
behaviors: Accepts a string scalar or character row vector and returns encoded text.
Preserves URL-safe characters and percent-encodes other UTF-8 bytes.
Numeric values, including native integer values, are not text and are rejected before provider access.
